# Title-block parity corpus (bd-gx9cic8z). P1 (bd-tezzk9vp): the
# *-title metadata options override the default heading labels.
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      noErrors: true
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - [
            "header#title-block-header.quarto-title-block.default",
            "div.quarto-title-meta",
          ]
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        - [
            'quarto-title-meta-heading">Written by<',
            'quarto-title-meta-heading">Posted<',
            'block-title">Summary<',
          ]
        - [
            'quarto-title-meta-heading">Author<',
            'quarto-title-meta-heading">Published<',
            '>Abstract<',
          ]
